description:
## What
Add two mutable state variables to the `chain_walk` function in pkix-path/src/lib.rs to track the running NameConstraints state across the chain traversal.

## Algorithm
Per RFC 5280 §6.1.2:
- `let mut permitted_subtrees: Option<Vec<GeneralSubtree>> = None;` — None = unconstrained
- `let mut excluded_subtrees: Vec<GeneralSubtree> = Vec::new();`

These are declared before the main loop and updated per-certificate by the state-update logic (separate issue).

## Acceptance criteria
- Variables declared with correct types from x509_cert
- No behavior change in this issue — just declare the variables (they will be used by subsequent issues)
- Compiles with no unused-variable warnings (annotate with _ prefix temporarily if needed, or use #[allow])
title: Add NC state variables to chain_walk
